hero.intro: I design identities, cut videos, build web and mobile products, and wire AI into the work that slows your team down. One person end to end — no hand-offs between agencies.

work.title: Recent
work.body: Corporate platforms, learning products, marketplaces and storefronts — shipped and in use.

pillars.title: Nine disciplines,
pillars.body: Grouped by the outcome you're after. AI runs through all four — as a tool for better work, not a gimmick.

about.title: One person,
about.body: I'm Mohammed — a designer and full-stack developer who also teaches frontend. You talk to the person doing the work, from the first sketch to the last deploy.

mentoring.title: I also teach what I build.
mentoring.body: A 40-hour frontend program, one-to-one code reviews, and AI-assisted development workflows for students and junior developers.
